Test Steps: Open register page; enter valid account details; submit
Test Criteria: Account is created and user can sign in

Test Steps: Open login page; enter valid credentials; submit
Test Criteria: Student dashboard visible; appropriate navigation shown

Test Steps: Open submission form; enter valid title, description and research type; submit
Test Criteria: Confirmation appears; new submission is shown as Pending

Test Steps: Open submission tracking/list; select the new record
Test Criteria: Correct title, type and current status visible

Test Steps: Try to access reviewer workflow or API
Test Criteria: Student cannot perform privileged review action

Test Steps: Log in as reviewer; open a pending submission; add feedback and Requires Changes
Test Criteria: Review saved; student sees Requires Changes

Test Steps: Open review; enter Accepted, date, time, location; save
Test Criteria: Accepted status and presentation details saved

Test Steps: Log out; attempt to revisit protected page
Test Criteria: Session cleared and protected page inaccessible
